svg.text: Test plate: what each hole is for
112 × 72 × 2.5 mm (2.5 = planned wall). Seen from the top (engraved side). Labels are engraved under each cutout.
Rows: top = rocker ×2, fuse, DB9 · bottom = barrel jack ×2, LED, USB, hole check. RJ jacks + RING button: drill + hot glue later.
check: press in: snug + clips grip = this one
check: use if R1 is too tight
check: flat side lines up, nut tightens
check: shell fits, standoffs grip through 2.5 mm
check: jack body slides in from behind
check: plug reaches the jack through 2.5 mm
check: measure: how much holes shrink
